notes: Read live off the bus (0x500) AND photographed on the vehicle's build
plate in the same session - the two agree character for character, so the
VIN decode is confirmed against a physical artifact.
WMI MA3 = Maruti Suzuki India. The plate also gives ENGINE NO. K10CN,
the K10C DualJet in its CNG form, which is consistent with the bi-fuel
badge and the CNG indicator lit on the dash.
Derived from a SINGLE observed VIN, so this prefix may be too narrow or
too wide. Note it differs from the Dzire's MA3CZF63S in the VDS, so the
two packs cannot be confused by VIN even though they share a bus map.
Only characters 1-9 are stored: manufacturer + model/body/powertrain.
The unit-identifying tail is deliberately omitted - this identifies a
MODEL, not a car. The build plate happens to print the split at exactly
Position 10 is 'N', which ISO 3779 would read as model year 2022. That is
